يستفهمون (form X)
# يَسْتَفْهِمُونَ (yastafhimūna) /jas.taf.hi.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
# يُسْتَفْهَمُونَ (yustafhamūna) /jus.taf.ha.muː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَفْهَمَ (istafhama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
